digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup/initialization and decision-bearing authentication
propositions: MCP and review-bot services must capture static deployment/startup config once at process start and compose a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot for each operation/request, preventing ambient re-reads of Gerrit/GitHub/LLM/telemetry material during in-flight operations
Inbound MCP bearer tokens must remain request-scoped transient context and never enter startup bindings, operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, or child environments

Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (gerrit_bot_token, GitHub credentials) before accepting a job/webhook and before dedup/clone/provider work, with no fallback to alternate principals on missing/conflicting/revoked credentials
Static provider bindings and policy must be observed only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned refreshable capabilities remain SDK-controlled and may refresh in-process
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must disable telemetry gracefully without changing the underlying operation result, while security/load-bearing auth remains fail-closed

Review-bot must thread the composed LLMRuntime from startup binding through CodeReviewRequest and code review decision logic, passing only the selected integration without exposing stronger server identity through CLI/MCP inputs
